messages:
marta: Quick check-in on postmortem follow-ups from last week's canary incident. Who owns each action and what's the ETA? I don't want these hanging.

cole: I'll own the auto-rollback tuning (canary->auto-roll after 2 minutes of elevated error rate). target: EOW next Friday. I need QA on the rollback threshold.

raj: I'll take blast-radius controls — gating rules + split traffic caps per region. plan: config PR by Tue, rollout next Thursday. Need someone to validate gating metrics.

ops-bot: deploy-bot noticed: canary rollout 2024-06-12 15:02 UTC -> 10% -> errors spiked at t+7m. auto-fallback not triggered (threshold=5% but spike was 4.9%).

sophia: We should add a regression monitor that watches for repeated small spikes across releases. I can prototype an alert recipe. ETA: 9 days.

marta: Action owners: cole(auto-rollback), raj(blast-radius), sophia(regression monitor). Add owners to the postmortem doc and set weekly check-ins until closed. Also need a recurring audit for feature-flag explosion in svc-auth.

cole: For rollback tuning, propose: require 3 consecutive 1m windows >=5% error AND total token loss > 1000. Will write config and test in staging. cc @marta

raj: For gating, I'll add per-flag hard cap + 'circuit breaker' that demotes traffic to safe-model when wtf. pseudo:
```
flag_config:
  max_pct: 0.1
  circuit: "error_rate>6% for 2m"
  fallback: safe-model
```

sophia: I'll put a PromQL alert and an eval harness. Also recommend a 'pattern detection' job that surfaces recurring 1-2% spikes over 30d.

marta: Great. @ops-bot can you export the last 90d canary spikes by service and attach to the postmortem doc?

ops-bot: exporting... done: link: https://redwood.internal/ops-canary-spikes/1719102468

cole: I'll add a small E2E to simulate a 7% spike to ensure auto-rollback fires.

raj: timeline check: PRs by Tue -> staging test Wed -> canary rollout Thu -> revert/close Fri. Owners confirm?

sophia: confirm. I'll start the alert work tomorrow.

marta: I'll create a weekly recurring "rollout safety" 15-min triage for owners until all items are closed. tagging this thread in the postmortem.

cole: ack :thumbsup:

raj: ack

sophia: ack
